title: Speaking — Local wildlife
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on local wildlife.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
Which animals or birds do you often see in your area?
Do you usually notice wildlife when walking?

part2.topic: Describe a moment when you noticed wildlife in an unexpected place.
part2.closing: and explain why the experience was memorable.

questions: How can cities make room for wildlife while meeting residents' needs?
What can ordinary people report that helps researchers study urban nature?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to local wildlife?
